headline: Oil prices rise after attack on Saudi Arabian refinery
summary: Global oil prices climbed following an attack on a Saudi Arabian oil refinery, raising fresh concerns over global energy supply.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude oil exporter, and disruptions to its refining infrastructure can significantly impact global energy markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude Oil
impacts.why: Disruptions to Saudi refining facilities reduce available crude supply.

why_moved: Supply disruptions from an attack on Saudi oil infrastructure directly push up crude benchmark prices.
